# DroidLume Agent Control

DroidLume Agent Control is an MCP server, CLI, and Agent Skill for controlling DroidLume-managed Android virtual devices on Apple silicon Macs.

Primary documentation:
- README: https://github.com/tageecc/droidlume-agent-control#readme
- Skill: https://github.com/tageecc/droidlume-agent-control/blob/main/SKILL.md
- Commands: https://github.com/tageecc/droidlume-agent-control/blob/main/references/commands.md
- MCP: https://github.com/tageecc/droidlume-agent-control/blob/main/references/mcp.md
- Errors: https://github.com/tageecc/droidlume-agent-control/blob/main/references/errors.md
- Releases: https://github.com/tageecc/droidlume-agent-control/releases/latest
- Official website: https://droidlume.talkape.net/agent-control/
